name: Shinozaki Ryoutarou
source:
The protagonist of the game who has a generally positive personality. Because of his parents' work, he was forced to move overseas constantly and as a result he struggled to adapt to school life aboard. At the same time, due to him having to constantly change schools, he developed strong communication skills and is able to easily strike up conversations even with strangers. Sometimes he has a habit of overthinking things when he's afraid of making mistakes or failing at something, but he usually manages to get out of these mental blocks quickly.

[From [url=https://www.hook-net.jp/eschoollife/]official website[/url]]
